key.name: poll-active
key.description: Used while the menu is open or the session is starting, recording, reconnecting or stopping.

key.name: poll-idle
key.description: Used while the session is stopped, paused or failed, or the server is not running.

key.name: microphone-stable-id
key.description: The chosen microphone's stable id from the server's microphone list (PipeWire node name); it survives reconnects. Empty = none chosen. The microphone is only ever turned on with the chosen one; if it is not connected the microphone stays off.

key.name: microphone-id
key.description: The chosen microphone's opaque id from the server's microphone list. It changes when the device reconnects, so it is only used when no stable id is saved (older servers, or before migration). Empty, or not currently present, = no microphone; there is no fallback to another one.

key.name: microphone-label
key.description: Stored when the microphone is chosen in the menu; shown in messages such as "… is not connected".

key.name: show-mic-indicator
key.summary: Show a microphone icon in the top bar while the microphone is on

key.name: report-active-window
key.summary: Report the focused window to the work session
key.description: Sends the focused window's app id, app name, WM class and title to the loopback work-session server, only while it is recording and offers window activity (--window-activity). Never while paused.

key.name: window-title-excluded-apps
key.summary: Apps whose window titles are never sent
key.description: Desktop app ids (with or without the .desktop suffix, e.g. org.keepassxc.KeePassXC). Their windows are reported with an empty title.

key.name: pause-reminder-minutes
key.summary: Remind after being paused this long (minutes)
key.description: While the work session stays paused, show a notification after this many minutes and again every this many minutes. Counted from when the extension first saw the pause. 0 = no reminders.

key.name: mic-reminder-minutes
key.summary: Remind to check the microphone after no speech for this long (minutes)
key.description: While the session is recording with the microphone on and the server transcribes audio, show a notification when no speech has been transcribed for this many minutes, and again every this many minutes. Counted from when the extension first saw the microphone on, or the last speech. Transcripts land about one audio segment (default 60 s) after the speech, so a delay of only a minute or two can remind while you are talking. Servers that don't report transcriptions with text, an audio limit reached or failed, and a captured output monitor never remind. 0 = no reminders.
